items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: We were always very awkward with each other. ... Bill was always difficult for me to talk to so I just didn't talk to him or he didn't talk to me much

ctx.x: Well, there's nothing like Friends. There are a lot of people who are collectors. Yeah. They just got like Friends.

Uh, did you ever go on Bill Russell's record shop? Yeah. I went to Bill Russell's record shop a number of times, although I think he, I think he came to town, well, probably around 52 or 53 when I was in San Francisco.
